name: Beauty is Only Crystal Deep!
subtitle: ビューティー・アンド・ニャース！Beauty and Nyarth!
plot: A Pheromosa emerges from an Ultra Wormhole over Melemele Island and runs into the forest. Meanwhile, Hala is busy working on his Z-Ring when he encounters Pheromosa. Soon, Professor Kukui wakes Ash up and alerts him to an emergency dispatch. The Ultra Guardians are all picked up by their respective Ride Pokémon, just as Hala's Hariyama is defeated by Pheromosa. The Ultra Beast then waltzes into Hala's home and grabs his Fightinium Z. The Ultra Guardians arrive on the scene in time to see Pheromosa run away, though Rotom only manages to get a blurry photograph of the intruder. Lillie checks on Hala, who then informs the group that his Z-Crystal has been stolen.The next day, the late-night disturbance has left Ash and his classmates too tired for Pokémon School. Suddenly, Komala rings the school bell, and the Ultra Guardians are called to the underground base for an upcoming mission. They are greeted by Lusamine and Professor Burnet shows the group their data on Pheromosa. Lusamine informs the group that the Ultra Beast appears to be targeting Trainers with Z-Crystals, including Kagetora, Pikala, and Hiroki. Wicke identifies the Ultra Beast as "Pheromosa", and Burnet urges the Ultra Guardians to solve the crisis. To Ash's surprise, the Meltan present the Ultra Guardians with their box of Beast Balls and medical kit. Clefable then rewards the Meltan with some bolts for their assistance. The Ultra Guardians launch out and fly aboard their Ride Pokémon to confront Pheromosa. Meanwhile, at Bewear's den, Pheromosa steals Team Rocket's Darkinium Z and Mimikium Z, but not before Meowth is captivated by its beauty. He decides to refer to Pheromosa as "Beauty" before noticing that it is collecting Z-Crystals.After seeing the Ultra Guardians flying overhead, Meowth decides to help Pheromosa find more Z-Crystals. Meowth flashes light at the Ultra Guardians with his golden kobana, which gets the group's attention and prompts them to land. They encounter Meowth and become suspicious when he asks them to use their Z-Moves on him. As Ash tries to use his Electrium Z, Pheromosa snatches it off his Z-Power Ring. Ash orders Pikachu to use Quick Attack, but Pheromosa dodges it. Jessie and James soon locate Meowth and notice his drastic appearance changes, including a verbal tic and standing on his toes. Meowth admits that he wishes to impress "Beauty", though Jessie simply wants the Z-Crystals back. James and Wobbuffet find Meowth's affection for the Ultra Beast to be hilarious, but Meowth is too blinded by his crush. He professes his love to Pheromosa, but the Ultra Beast runs off again, and Meowth follows.The Ultra Guardians return to the base, where Faba reveals his latest invention, the "Sticky Stuck Soles Faba Special". He explains that the wheel on the side will release a gel adhesive around the device, while the Z-Crystal in the bowl will act as a bait. Faba, however, gets stuck in the adhesive. Ash and the others are skeptical, but nevertheless, they set up the device as described in a rocky outcrop and place some Z-Crystals into the dish. Sophocles releases the adhesive before everyone waits in hiding for Pheromosa to arrive. Team Rocket spies on the setup from some nearby bushes and decides to steal the Z-Crystals. Just then, Meowth and Pheromosa stumble onto the trap. Meowth is quick to realize the Z-Crystals are just bait and gets himself stuck in the adhesive. Pheromosa then uses Meowth as a stepping stone and takes all of the Z-Crystals before fleeing the area. Kiawe declares that they will have to face Pheromosa head on. He, Ash, and Lana prepare to attack the Ultra Beast with Turtonator, Lycanroc, and Brionne, respectively.As the trio charges up their Pokémon with Z-Power, Pheromosa knocks the Pokémon back and swipes three more Z-Crystals. Snowy, Tsareena, and Togedemaru's sneak attack also fails. Jessie orders her Mimikyu to use Shadow Ball, but it instead aims at Pikachu. James has a try, but Pheromosa dodges Mareanie's Spike Cannon as well. Pheromosa rushes towards the trio and overpowers Wobbuffet's Counter attempt. Frustrated at seeing his teammates injured, Meowth manages to free himself of the sticky adhesive and urges Pheromosa to stop attacking them. Pheromosa is unimpressed and kicks Meowth back into the glue pit. Meowth pleads with Pheromosa, but she is despondent. Meowth is left heartbroken, having realized that he was simply being manipulated. Just then, Stufful appears and snuggles up to Team Rocket, after which Bewear appears.Bewear notices Meowth trapped in the glue and Team Rocket cowering among the rocks, prompting her to confront Pheromosa. The two Fighting types engage in a battle of strengths. Bewear takes Pheromosa by surprise after she knocks it into a cliff. She then corners Pheromosa, though the Ultra Beast is not giving up. Pheromosa attempts to confuse its opponent with its speed, but the tactic fails as Bewear delivers a powerful uppercut. Pheromosa hits the ground and the stolen Z-Crystals fall all around it. Bewear picks up Team Rocket's Z-Crystals, Meowth, and the others before fleeing the scene. As the Ultra Guardians are momentarily perplexed by Bewear's strength, Rotom urges Ash to make the catch, and with Pheromosa knocked out, the Beast Ball successfully captures it. The Ultra Guardians perform their victory pose, although Kiawe is quick to remind them that Bewear is really the one to thank, depressing Ash. Later, Burnet arrives and opens up an Ultra Wormhole with a machine. Ash then calls Pheromosa out. Displeased about being caught, it sticks out its tongue as it returns to Ultra Space. The Ultra Wormhole closes over and Rotom officially declares the Ultra Guardians' mission complete. Ash is relieved, but Sophocles reminds him that they still need to return the Z-Crystals to their rightful owners. Lillie wonders how Faba is doing, and it is revealed that he is still stuck in the adhesive, until Wicke suggests that he take off his clothes. With no other choice, Faba is forced to strip down to his underwear and walk away in embarrassment.Back at Bewear's den, Meowth is still heartbroken. Bewear arrives with a cache of Berries and shoves a giant Grepa Berry into Meowth's mouth. Jessie and James are quick to remind him that he belongs with them, and the camaraderie begins to cheer up Meowth.
major_events: Ash and his classmates go on their seventh Ultra Guardians mission.
The Ultra Guardians catch a Pheromosa and release it back into Ultra Space.

name: The Dealer of Destruction!
subtitle: 破壊の帝王グズマ！Emperor of Destruction Guzma!
plot: Outside the Pokémon School, Ash and Pikachu are busy practicing their Steel-type Z-Move Corkscrew Crash, which allows Pikachu to easily drill his way through a series of wooden obstacles set up for him. Both Ash and his classmates are excited, with Sophocles and Mallow wanting to try out one too. Just then, Samson Oak exits the school building and reminds everyone of the important announcement that Professor Kukui is due to make at Aether Paradise.At Aether Paradise, a crowd and members of the press have gathered, with Professor Burnet welcoming Ash and his classmates. The press conference begins, during which Professor Kukui announces the first-ever Alolan Pokémon League, in which the winner of the tournament will become Alola's first-ever Champion. The press conference is broadcast live across the region and observed by people all over Alola, including Gladion and Team Rocket. The trio starts dreaming about the possibilities achievable through winning a championship, like giving the entire archipelago as a gift to the Boss.Back at Aether Paradise, Kukui presents the crowd with island kahunas Hala, Nanu, Olivia, and Hapu, as well as Lusamine of the Aether Foundation, who have agreed to support his idea. The kahunas mention the custom of the island challenge and how it once included a now-abandoned tradition in which those who cleared all four grand trials must climb to the summit of Mount Lanakila and battle each other there, before explaining that Professor Kukui decided to revive that tradition in a form that anyone can participate in. Lusamine reveals that the Aether Foundation is building the Pokémon League stadium a short distance away from Aether Paradise.After the press conference ends, both Ash and Kiawe immediately decide to join the League. When Principal Oak asks the rest of Ash's classmates if they want to join too, Lana is quick to accept, and Sophocles also shows interest due to his newly evolved Vikavolt. Mallow also encourages Lillie to join, reminding her of the successful Double Battle she had a while back, though both girls are uncertain about participating.At Po Town on Ula'ula Island, Team Skull Grunts are spending time at the Shady House when Plumeria enters and announces the return of their boss, Guzma, who steps in through the front door, much to the Grunts' excitement. While Guzma asks everyone how they are doing, Tupp, Rapp, and Zipp rush in, informing Guzma about the announcement of the Pokémon League. They turn on a TV and go to a report about Kukui's League announcement. The same report is also being watched by Ash, Kukui, and Burnet at Kukui's house on Melemele Island. Ash asks Kukui if he thinks the Masked Royal is going to participate in the League, and Kukui hastily explains that because the Masked Royal is a mysterious character, he can't be sure. Regardless of that, Ash swears to start training for the League the next day. At the Shady House, Team Skull observes the interviews for each of the island kahunas regarding their thoughts about the Pokémon League. Plumeria asks Guzma what he wants to do, and he declares that he is going to destroy the Pokémon League. He then tells his minions that they are going to Melemele Island.The next day, Ash and his team begin running along the beach as part of their training. Meanwhile, in Hau'oli City, Team Rocket notices a poster about the Pokémon League and decides to start training for it as well. Just then, Tupp, Rapp, and Zipp arrive, mocking the trio and performing their introduction rap. Not wanting to be outdone, Team Rocket performs a rap version of their own motto, leaving James and Meowth momentarily exhausted. While both trios prepare to battle, Guzma steps in and says that he will deal with the Team Rocket trio himself, saying that it will be a good warm-up for Kukui. He tells them to come at him all at once, swearing to destroy them. Soon enough, Team Skull exits the scene, while a defeated Team Rocket lies on the ground in their wake. Bewear then emerges from a nearby concrete pipe, scoops up Team Rocket, and runs away.At the Pokémon School, Kukui is in the middle of explaining the Pokémon League to his class when Team Skull starts calling to him from the schoolyard, telling him to come talk to them. He goes down and tells them to save their talk for later, but his attitude changes when he recognizes Guzma. Ash and his classmates follow Kukui to the schoolyard, and Plumeria tells them they can witness the match between Kukui and Guzma. Guzma emphasizes that he is not going to battle Kukui, but rather destroy him. He goes on to call the island challenge and island kahunas outdated customs and adds that a Pokémon League is just as unnecessary, as he already considers himself the strongest Trainer around. Kukui asks why he won't just join the League to prove his strength, but Guzma shoots down the idea. He swears to destroy the League if Kukui doesn't back down. Kukui refuses, noting that Guzma hasn't changed at all. Ash then steps in and asks Guzma to have a battle with him. Guzma notices Ash's Z-Power Ring, and Ash tells him that he has cleared all four grand trials. Ash instantly reminds Guzma of Kukui, so he accepts his challenge. Kukui tries to talk to Ash, but he asks Kukui to leave this to him, which he agrees to, saying that he will act as the referee. Guzma swears to destroy Ash, but Kukui tells Guzma not to underestimate him.As the two prepare to battle, Ash chooses Pikachu, while Guzma sends out Golisopod. Rotom scans Golisopod and gives Ash its Pokédex entry, noting that Pikachu has the type advantage over his Bug/Water-type opponent. However, once Kukui starts the battle, Guzma immediately calls for a First Impression, dealing the first blow to Pikachu. Ash has Pikachu use Iron Tail, but the attack is ineffective against Golisopod's diamond-hard armor. Guzma orders a Pin Missile barrage, which Pikachu counters with Electroweb before using Thunderbolt. However, Golisopod deflects the normally super-effective move, much to Ash and Rotom's surprise. Ash decides to put the results of his training to use and performs Corkscrew Crash with Pikachu. However, Golisopod blocks and deflects the Z-Move with its armor-plated hands, surprising everyone. Guzma then orders Golisopod to use Liquidation, striking Pikachu while he is still reorienting himself. Ash has Pikachu use Quick Attack, but Golisopod retaliates with a Poison Jab, poisoning Pikachu in the process. Pikachu attacks with Iron Tail, but gets stopped in his tracks by a volley of Pin Missiles from Golisopod. Despite the poison and the numerous hits, Pikachu is still able to stand up. Ash orders a Quick Attack, and this time, Pikachu dodges the incoming Poison Jab and strikes Golisopod's unarmored underside, causing the tall Bug type to flinch.Although Pikachu is getting weaker as the battle wages on, he still refuses to stay down, much to Guzma's irritation. Pikachu and Golisopod stare at each other for a moment, until Golisopod suddenly turns and uses its Emergency Exit Ability to return to its Poké Ball, surprising Ash and Pikachu. Guzma says that Golisopod deemed Ash so weak that it lost all interest, irritating Ash. Kukui asks if Guzma is throwing the match, and he responds that he has no interest in continuing a battle with an obvious outcome. Ash protests that he can't say that for sure unless he finishes the battle, but Guzma dismisses him. Ash's attention then turns to Pikachu, who collapses from the effects of the poison. Kiawe tosses Ash a Pecha Berry, which he gives to Pikachu to heal his poison. Plumeria tells Ash that he should join Team Skull, but he rejects the suggestion without a second of hesitation. Guzma declares that he will destroy the Pokémon League while all of Alola is watching, but Kukui then steps in and asks Guzma if he's going to just run away again, just like he did with the island challenge. Guzma and Kukui glare at each other for a while, until Guzma says that he almost let himself be thrown off again and that Ash made him change his mind about destroying Kukui. He and the rest of Team Skull then turn around and walk away.Later, back at the Shady House, Tupp asks Plumeria where Guzma is, and she replies that he's upstairs in his room making plans for the destruction of the upcoming Pokemon League. Upstairs, Guzma recalls Kukui's words about running away, and punches the wall in front of him in frustration.
major_events: Ash and Pikachu perform Corkscrew Crash for the first time.
Professor Kukui officially announces the first-ever Alola League, whose winner will become Alola's first-ever Champion.
The League Conference is revealed to be held at a yet-to-be-completed stadium near Aether Paradise.
Ash, Lana, Kiawe, Sophocles, and Team Rocket decide to participate in the Alola League, while Mallow and Lillie consider doing so too.
Ash, his classmates, and Team Rocket meet the Team Skull Boss Guzma for the first time.
Ash's classmates and Team Rocket meet Plumeria for the first time.
Team Rocket has a battle with Guzma and are defeated.
Ash has a battle with Guzma, but the battle ends when Guzma's Golisopod activates its Emergency Exit Ability.
